title: FindingRecord
description: One line of a workspace's findings.jsonl in the store (docs/design/export.md): a finding episode, written as it closes, as it was shown. Keyed by id, finding- and 16 hex characters of SHA-256 over the heuristic, session and first time. It matches the FindingRecord type in storeRecords.ts; a unit test and a compile-time check keep them in step.

heuristicId.description: The heuristic's or saved rule's id.

heuristicVersion.description: A built-in's Snagboat version, or a hash of a saved rule's definition.

sessionId.description: The session of its latest event.

summary.description: The latest finding's summary, as shown.
